description: Replay a recorded F1 session against your registered webhooks. Session data is delivered to your active webhook endpoints at the chosen speed. Self-serve tiers cover the current season (the full historical archive is on Custom); delivering a session you have not replayed before consumes one of your unique-session simulate slots (Free 5, Developer 10). Use this to develop and test your integration without waiting for a live race.

feeds.description: Limit playback to specific feed IDs. Omit to replay all subscribed feeds.

sessionId.description: Session ID from list_events (e.g. a qualifying or race session ID).

speed.description: Playback speed multiplier (1 = real-time, 10 = 10× speed, 'instant' = as fast as possible).

name: start_simulation
